SELECT w.status, s.store_id=900 AS is_web, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(r.sales_line_id) ret_lines, sum(r.refund_net) refunds, min(f.net_amount) minnet, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.store_id, s.format, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2),
refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(quantity_returned) qty, max(return_date) last_ret, count(*) n FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.format, s.store_id=999 AS is999, s.category='ZZ Test' AS zz, count(*) lines, sum(s.net_amount) sold, sum(r.refund_net) refunded, 
  sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > s.net_amount + 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_refund, sum(CASE WHEN r.qty > s.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty, max(r.last_ret) last_ret, max(r.n) maxn
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
